{el} brings Order, the energy your chart is shortest of. It gives your strength a shape, and you finish what you start today.
{el} brings Order, the energy you need most. A rule or a deadline lands on you, and you meet it at full strength.
{el} brings Action, an energy you already hold and still need. It hands you more to work with than you can use, and you choose well.
{el} brings Mind, the energy your chart already has too much of. Your thoughts circle, and you get less done than you meant to.
{el} brings more Body, your own energy, when you already run over. You push harder than the day needs, and you notice it by evening.
{el} brings Expression, the outlet your chart is short of. Words come easily today, and you say what you have been holding back.
{el} brings Mind for a whole month, the energy your chart already has too much of. You move slower and think longer, and you hold your ground well.
{el} brings Order for a whole year, the energy you need most. It presses on you from outside, and you end the year harder to bend.
Under it runs {g}, which feeds the {e}, and you feel it hold all the way through.
Under it runs {g}, which draws the {e} off, and you feel it soften as it goes.
Under it runs {g}, which the {e} holds down, and you put both to work.
Under it runs {g}, which pushes back against the {e}, and you feel the two pull apart.
Under it runs more {g}, and you feel it at full strength.
units.shows: 21 Oct, the Cold Dew month, the 2026 year

units.text: A plan for later gets pushed back, a promise to someone younger or a date you set. You keep the plan and let the date move.
A plan you settled at work comes loose, and someone asks you to defend it. You defend it in fewer words than you expected.
A plan at home changes at short notice, with a partner or the people you live with. You adjust faster than the people around you.
An old argument at home comes back, or a chore that never stays done. You settle it by evening, on your own terms.
Someone from the home you grew up in reaches you, with a call or a message or an old habit. You answer more warmly than you planned.
Home draws you in, and a small plan with a partner settles easily. You spend the evening closer than usual.
A role or a routine you settled comes loose this month, and you rebuild it in a different shape. You end the month with fewer duties and a firmer hold on the ones you keep.
You feel the whole month's clash come to a head today, because the month presses on the same gate.
Today repeats the day you were born on, as it does six times a year. What you started in the last two months comes back, and you see it more clearly this time.
Today is your own day turned over, its stem striking yours and its branch clashing your Day Gate. Something settled at home is questioned, and you answer for it calmly.
A new month opens today, and its energy holds until the next one. You feel the change before you can name it.
A new year opens today, and its energy runs until next February. You feel the turn before you can name it.
Your new year of age begins today. You start it on your own day, with your own energy at full strength.
The day falls in your Void. What starts today arrives late or lighter than promised, and you notice it first.
Help comes from someone with standing, an older colleague or a person who owes you nothing. You accept it without having to ask twice.
